text.en:
12th. DECEMBER, 201 7 No. S 86 SYARIAH COURTS CIVIL PROCEDURE {SULH] RULES, 2013 (S 3412013) Notification of commencement In exercise of the power conferred by section 111) of the Syariah Courts Civil Procedure (Sulh) Rules, 2013, the Chief Syar'ie Judge hereby appoints 2nd January 2018 as the date on which that Rules shall commence. Dated this 1st. day of Rabiulawal, 1439 Hijriah corresponding to the 20th. day of November, 2017.

PEHIN ORANG KAYA PADUKA SERI UTAMA

DATO PADUKA SERI SETIA USTAZ HAJI AWANG SALIM

BIN HAJI BESAR Chief Syar'ie Judge, Brunei Darussalam.
